# HyperFrames skills

The four folders here (`hyperframes`, `hyperframes-animation`, `hyperframes-cli`, `hyperframes-core`) are agent skills from
https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes, licensed under the Apache License 2.0 (see `LICENSE`). They are copied as installed on the
studio author's PC and may contain small local edits (for example the studio render-contract notice at the top of a SKILL.md).
`Install-Studio.ps1` copies them into `.agents/skills/` where the studio's forwarding skills expect them.
